capabilities: Visualize daily net word, line, or character changes as a contribution-graph heatmap
Scope heatmaps to chosen folders or tags, with separate scopes per sidebar or embedded heatmap
Show a per-file breakdown on hover and total changes across a dragged date range
Embed a rolling-year or month heatmap in notes via a code block
extras: Not yet in the community plugin directory; install via BRAT or manually from a release. Relies on an undocumented Obsidian Sync API, so updates could break it. Excludes Excalidraw drawings; cache holds only dates, paths, version IDs, and aggregate counts with no telemetry.
intentEvidence: turns your Obsidian Sync version history into a contribution graph for your vault
problem: Obsidian shows no at-a-glance view of when and how much you wrote over time; Sync keeps version history but nothing visualizes it as daily activity.

relations.evidence: Edit History Heatmap turns your Obsidian Sync version history into a contribution graph

summary: Heatmap plugin that turns Obsidian Sync version history into a GitHub-style contribution graph of daily vault edits.
